title: unforge.press.v0
description: Record returned by UNFORGE Press. Prints ids from a UNFORGE-PREUVE-v1 card. Does not open the signature. Does not verify a file. ok: true is not a match — that is unforge-check.

ok.description: Card is UNFORGE-PREUVE-v1 and the A5 HTML was written. Not a file-match verdict. Not a seal.

sha256.description: objet.sha256 as written on the card. Printed, not recomputed.

empreinte.description: Card fingerprint as written. Printed, not recomputed.

html.description: Path of the A5 artifact when written.
